requirements: Trusted oracle process MUST NOT import or execute candidate-controlled Python.
Candidate observer processes MAY return only untrusted observations, outputs, or exceptions; they MUST NOT supply an authority-bearing PASS/FAIL decision.
Trusted oracle MUST derive every qualification-contributing PASS/FAIL from independently held expectations or invariants applied to untrusted observations.
Candidate-side unittest outcomes, worker envelopes, stdout, exit code, test names, and result objects MUST NOT satisfy mandatory qualification evidence.
All six mandatory V6 adversarial checks MUST be implemented as external trusted-oracle assertions.
Runtime-generated challenge material SHOULD be used to avoid static fixture-label equivalence where the domain contract permits it.
R12 frame-introspection attack MUST remain unable to create oracle PASS even if the candidate observer process emits a syntactically valid success-looking payload.

External oracle evidence MUST bind exact candidate commit/tree, oracle and observer identities, request/challenge digest, raw observation digest, assertion digest, run/round identity, and oracle terminal result.
Missing, stale, duplicate, self-authored, candidate-decided, or name-only oracle evidence MUST fail closed.
